title: 98: Sequel – Romain Lefebvre
description: On the podcast: Romain Lefebvre shares how he built Sequel, a media tracker for movies, TV, games, books, and audiobooks, after years of designing fintech apps left him craving something more visual. He talks about writing down two founding design principles before coding a single feature, why he still thinks his original pricing model backfired, and how a MacStories review turned a quiet hobby project into the most word-of-mouth-recommended media tracker on the internet, catching the attention of Quinn Nelson of Snazzy Labs and David Pierce of The Verge without spending a dollar on ads.
